methodology.denominator: Weighted user-visible behavior families that can be implemented in pure Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Canvas.
methodology.formula: For each capability, verified behavior count divided by behavior count, multiplied by capability weight. The total is normalized to 100 percent.
methodology.verified: Source-mapped implementation with repository test evidence. Rendered behavior also cites the shared visual corpus.
methodology.implemented: Code exists, but the behavior lacks focused official or lifecycle evidence and receives no score.
methodology.pending: The portable behavior is not implemented and receives no score.
methodology.excluded: The assessed behavior requires a browser, DOM, non-Compose renderer, excluded license branch, or explicitly out-of-scope upstream module. It is reported but removed from the portable denominator.
nonClaims: This score is not source-symbol mapping coverage.
This score is not Stable release qualification.
This score does not claim browser DOM or non-Compose renderer compatibility.

exclusions.reason: Upstream unused modules, including symbolic.js, are outside the project scope.
The legacy Internet Explorer VML backend is not applicable to Compose Canvas.
The embedded implementation is LGPL-derived and excluded by the MIT-only policy.
DOM nodes, WebView, browser globals, renderer probing, XMLHttpRequest, fullscreen, and native browser event plumbing are host-specific rather than portable behavior.
The production backend is Compose Canvas; renderer-independent geometry and style semantics remain in scope.

exclusions.scope: Browser math-typesetting engines and exact browser text layout
exclusions.reason: MathJax, KaTeX, ASCIIMathML, HTML metrics, CSS layout, and exact DOM glyph placement require the excluded browser host; portable plain-text and supported super/subscript semantics remain in scope and are verified separately.
